text:
maria_cto: Thanks for coming to the security segment. Quick follow-up thread: folks asked for SOC2 scope clarity, VPC/private control plane timeline, audit log retention tiers, and BYOK/HSM roadmap. I'll collect action items here.

anna_security: Short answers: SOC2 scope will include hosted API + Console for initial report (target: end of Q2). Dedicated/Dedicated-control-plane (reserved capacity) will be in scope later (we're targeting Q4). I'll upload a scope + exclusions doc today.

devon_infra: Private control plane pilot: onboarding for 2 pilot customers starts next week. Private deployment (VPC) GA planned after pilot feedback; we still need an installer flow and onboarding checklist.

sam_product: Customer ask: do we support BYOK with HSM or just cloud-managed keys initially? Need to prioritize customers asking for HSM-backed keys.

anna_security: BYOK timeline: Q3 initial BYOK via cloud KMS (customer-managed keys, KEK support). Q4 we aim to integrate partner HSMs for FIPS/HSM-backed BYOK. We'll require a key-rotation & attestations playbook.

ops-lead: Audit logs: default hosted retention = 90 days. Enterprise tiers: 1 year and 7 years (add-on). Logged fields include request metadata, model id/version, route, and token counts. We redact PII and raw prompt bodies by default; customers can request additional logging under contract.

alex_pm: I'll draft a SOC2 evidence request template and a "what we collect" summary customers can share with auditors.

maria_cto: Action items (owners & due next Wed EOD): anna -> SOC2 scope doc + carve-outs; devon -> pilot status + onboarding checklist + installer notes; ops-lead -> retention tiers + runbook for log requests; sam -> collate HSM customer asks and priority. Ping me if you need more time.

devon_infra: One infra note: proposed KMS rotation 90d may break long-running KV caches and sessions. Suggest either 180d rotation or key-versioning with rewrap support.

anna_security: Good point. We'll synchronize on rotation policy and retro-compat notes. Proposed policy snippet for discussion:

```
resource "redwood_kms_key" "customer" {
  rotation_period = "180d"
  allow_backup = false
  key_usage = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT"
}
```

devon_infra: Also need alerting for decrypt failures and a runbook to avoid customer-impacting incidents. ops-lead can own the alerts + pagerflow?

ops-lead: Yep. I'll add an alert rule for key-decrypt-failure, trace links in the console, and a short escalation runbook. Target: share doc by EOD Tue.

security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 gap review meeting Thu 10:00am (zoom.link) :bell:

maria_cto: Thanks all. Keeping this brief. If you can't meet the deadlines, @me and we'll reassign. :thumbsup:
